dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good afternoon. Welcome to the River View Hotel.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd ˌæftərˈnuːn. ˈwɛlkəm tə ðə ˈrɪvər ˈvjuː hoʊˈtɛl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hi. I'd like to check in, please. I have a reservation.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ. aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈtʃɛk ˈɪn, ˈpliːz. aɪ ˈhæv ə ˌrɛzərˈveɪʃən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Nam. I booked a room online two weeks ago.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm. aɪ ˈbʊkt ə ˈruːm ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ˈtuː ˈwiːks əˈɡoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, here it is. A room for two people, for two nights.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈhɪr ɪt ˈɪz. ə ˈruːm fər ˈtuː ˈpiːpəl, fər ˈtuː ˈnaɪts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's right. My sister has just texted me. She's on her way.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈraɪt. maɪ ˈsɪstər hæz ˈdʒʌst ˈtɛkstɪd miː. ʃiːz ɑːn hɜːr ˈweɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. And when are you going to check out?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ənd ˈwɛn ər juː ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈtʃɛk ˈaʊt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: On Sunday morning. We've just arrived from Bangkok, and we're very hungry!
dialogue.reading: ɑːn ˈsʌndeɪ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ. wiːv ˈdʒʌst əˈraɪvd frəm ˈbæŋkɑːk, ənd wɪr ˈvɛri ˈhʌŋɡri!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Then try our restaurant next to reception. It has just opened for dinner.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈtraɪ aʊr ˈrɛstərɑːnt ˈnɛkst tə rɪˈsɛpʃən. ɪt hæz ˈdʒʌst ˈoʊpənd fər ˈdɪnər.
